description: Reads a diagram by id or key. The default outline: a header (id, title, revision, time, hash), the brief, recent versions, one element per line nested by container, and edges as 'id: from -> to'. view 'dsp' returns the scene JSON, 'mermaid' Mermaid to edit and send back to diagram_edit. revision or asOf reads an earlier version; knownRevision, only what changed since; elements, only those elements and their neighbors. Another workspace's diagram answers NOT_FOUND.

asOf.description: 2026-06-30 (end of day, UTC) or ISO 8601 with an offset

name: diagram_get
title: Read a diagram
